C1244.title: Beauty Salon Induces BNPL Sign-Up, Processes Contract Without Customer Consent
C1244.summary: In a 2024 Guangdong consumer rights case, a Huizhou consumer identified as Ms. Wu visited a skin management shop for an acne treatment. Staff took her phone under the pretext of needing a signature for the trial service and used the opportunity to sign her up for a 'buy now, pay later' installment agreement without her consent.
